title: Law to require sidewalk-detection tech on shared e-bikes and scooters
summary: This bill would require companies operating e-bike and e-scooter share systems to install sidewalk riding detection technology and an automatic braking feature that gradually stops a device detected riding on a sidewalk. A first violation would carry no penalty, but repeat violations within two years could bring a civil fine of up to $1,000. The law would take effect one year after passage.
